name: Resistor Environment QA 27
description: Multiple choice question about electricity, resistors and current QA: Effective resistance in a complex resistor network

examples.input: What is the effective resistance between A and C for the circuit with following topology {"resistors": {"R1": 10.0/4, "R2": 10.0, "R3": 30.0, "R4": 20.0}, "connections": [["A", "B", "R1"], ["B", "C", "R2"], ["B", "C", "R3"], ["A", "C", "R4"]]}}?
